> Configure project :core:ui-components:example-design-system:global-fused
WARNING: Fused Library Plugin is using Publication Only Mode.

                    Depending on Fused Library projects from other projects is not fully supported.

                    Local Fused Library projects will not be able to be added as project dependencies to other modules.
                    If you wish to depend on a fused library, consider publishing as an external library using
                    maven-publish plugin and using the fusedLibraryComponent component.
                    
Add android.sync.suppressAgpWarnings=FUSED_LIBRARY_PUBLICATION_ONLY_MODE to the gradle.properties file to suppress this warning.
